plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Bootstrap and operate Karpathy-style LLM Wikis: create-llm-wiki scaffolds a new vault; use-llm-wiki ingests into / queries an existing vault from anywhere.

plugins.name: data-viz-design
plugins.description: Publication-grade plots, charts, and dashboards for expert/executive audiences (Tufte, Knaflic, Cairo, Andrews).

plugins.name: diagnose-network-latency
plugins.description: Diagnose slow/laggy/flaky internet on macOS and pinpoint the root cause (interference, congestion, signal, VPN, DNS, ISP).

plugins.name: llm-council
plugins.description: Convene a panel of model instances to pressure-test a decision or answer a question from multiple perspectives, then synthesize.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Generate a dense, technical State of the Project summary for clean session handoffs — maximizes context continuity while minimizing token cost in the next window.

plugins.name: everything-tracker
plugins.description: Sync Kobo highlights into the personal LLM wiki — pulls highlights from the Kobo cloud API, enriches each book with Open Library metadata, and writes structured raw files ready for wiki ingest.

plugins.name: storm-research
plugins.description: Multi-perspective research pipeline (Stanford STORM method): five expert lenses, contradiction mapping, verified HTML briefing, and local LLM Wiki cross-referencing.

plugins.name: agent-practice-audit
plugins.description: Audit coding agent practices — inspects CLAUDE.md config files, skill inventory, and recent session transcripts for anti-patterns. Produces a scored report with actionable recommendations.

plugins.name: find-research-papers
plugins.description: Discover recent research papers relevant to your interests (derived from an LLM Wiki vault), rank into a recency-badged digest rendered as a local self-contained HTML page, with an optional subagent-powered deep dive (idea diagram + mechanism). Free sources: arXiv, Semantic Scholar, WebSearch.

plugins.name: quentin-writing-style
plugins.description: Write or edit technical documents in Quentin's personal voice (English and French), distilled from his first-author physics publications.

plugins.name: meal-planner
plugins.description: Weekly meal planning for the family — plan menus, save recipes, rate meals, generate grocery lists, and push them to Apple Reminders.
